context.content: The fictional Aster hub sits between one local probe and the external controller. It validates samples but does not choose irrigation actions.

fields.system_boundary: The hub owns sampling, validation, short-term buffering, and export; probe hardware and controller decisions are outside.
fields.external_actors: The local probe supplies readings and the external controller requests and receives validated readings.

composition.content: A collector validates each sample, a ring buffer retains the latest ten valid readings, and an exporter answers controller requests.

fields.parts: Collector, UTC clock, ten-entry ring buffer, and export adapter are the only parts in this worked architecture.
fields.relationships: Collector writes validated readings to the buffer; exporter reads but never mutates buffered history; the clock supplies UTC timestamps.

behavior.content: Startup initializes an empty buffer, periodic operation appends valid samples, and an export outage leaves collection running without discarding history.

fields.interactions: Probe samples enter the collector, valid readings move to the buffer, and controller queries trigger export of the newest reading.
fields.states: Empty, collecting, and degraded-export states explain startup, normal sampling, and temporary controller unavailability.

constraints.content: The buffer is deliberately bounded and export is read-only to prevent a slow controller from mutating sensor history or exhausting memory.

fields.constraints: Capacity is ten: retain the newest min(number of valid samples received, 10) readings, starting empty; use UTC at every boundary, reject non-finite values, and never block collection on export.
fields.design_rationale: A small read-only history is sufficient for the example and isolates sampling reliability from controller behavior.

trace.content: The architecture traces to Example::Sensor, Example::Controller, the stated sampling requirements, and a planned buffer/export verification case.

fields.model_elements: Example::Sensor and Example::Controller are the fictional model participants for composition and exchange.
fields.requirements_links: The 60-second sampling and latest-valid-reading requirements own the observable behavior.
fields.verification_links: Planned buffer-capacity and export-outage cases cover the main architectural constraints.
